description_ru: Двое друзей заказывают завтрак и обсуждают планы на день. Полезные фразы для заказа еды.
text:
Waiter: Good morning! What would you like to drink?
Vera: I would like a large coffee with milk, please.
Victor: And I want a glass of water and a cup of tea.
Waiter: Certainly. Would you like something to eat?
Vera: Yes, I am very hungry. What is the soup today?
Waiter: It is vegetable soup with fresh bread. It is better than the chicken soup.
Vera: Then I will have the vegetable soup, please.
Victor: I think I will try the cheese sandwich. Is it big?
Waiter: It is bigger than a plate, so be careful!
Victor: Wonderful! After breakfast, we are going to walk to the river.
Vera: Good idea. The weather is warm, and the water looks lovely.
Waiter: Here is your coffee, and your tea will be ready in two minutes.
Victor: Thank you very much.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Верхние зубы касаются нижней губы, голос включён; не округляйте губы, как для w.
Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро раскройте; зубы не касаются губы, не «в».
Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».

questions.question: What does Victor want to eat?
Where are they going to walk?
